risks.title: Goodwill Impairment
risks.score_rationale: Impairment risk is high due to the significant goodwill value ($2,065 million) and asset value sensitivity to interest rate and market changes. The International and Foodservice reporting units have only a 2% and 18% margin, respectively, above their carrying value.

risks.title: Interest Rate Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to interest rate changes, with approximately 28% of total debt subject to floating rates. Rising interest rates would reduce discounted cash flows and negatively impact the fair value of reporting units.

risks.title: Foreign Exchange Volatility
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in over 20 countries and is exposed to foreign exchange fluctuations. In 2025, favorable currency effects contributed $57 million to revenue changes.

risks.title: Tax Regulation
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to complex tax regulations and benefited from $8 million in federal tax credits in 2025.

risks.title: Asset Depreciation
risks.score_rationale: The company recorded a $9 million reduction in accelerated depreciation in 2025 related to facility closures. Future depreciation risk exists due to ongoing facility closures (Middletown in May 2025, East Angus in December 2025).

risks.title: Market Competition
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a highly competitive market and competes on innovation, price, and execution capability. The 2% revenue decline reflects volume and pricing pressures.

risks.title: Supply Chain and Commodity Inflation
risks.score_rationale: The company faced $47 million in inflation on purchased materials, energy, and logistics in 2025, partially offset by savings on recycled fibers. Labor and benefits inflation added $106 million in additional costs.

risks.title: Litigation Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company did not disclose any significant litigation in the provided 10-K.

ai_positioning.summary: GPK does not mention artificial intelligence (AI) or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F filing.
